Name: Starwarp
Author: Akoirium38
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8]Starwarp adds new warp totems that take you straight to the places you visit most: Pierre's shop, the Wizard's Tower, Robin's Carpenter Shop, Marnie's Ranch, your own bed, a personal Starpoint you place yourself, another farmer in multiplayer, and more... [/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install the latest version of SMAPI (4.5.2 or newer). [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download Starwarp and unzip it into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Run the game through SMAPI. [/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]In multiplayer, every player needs the mod installed. To uninstall, delete the Starwarp folder from Mods. Any totems or Starpoints left in your save will become error items, so use or remove them first. [/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[b]Totems[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Rich Totem[/b]: warps to Pierre's General Store. Recipe: 1 Gold Bar, 10 Sap, 1 Hardwood. Unlocked by mail from Pierre at 2 hearts.[/*]
[*][b]Magical Totem[/b]: warps to the Wizard's Tower. Recipe: 1 Void Essence,  Solar Essence, 1 Hardwood. Unlocked by mail from the Wizard at 2 hearts.[/*]
[*][b]Hardwork Totem[/b]: warps to Robin's Carpenter Shop. Recipe: 50 Wood, 25 Stone, 1 Hardwood. Unlocked by mail from Robin at 2 hearts.[/*]
[*][b]Hay Totem[/b]: warps to Marnie's Ranch. Recipe: 10 Hay, 1 Mayonnaise, 1 Hardwood. Unlocked by mail from Marnie at 2 hearts.[/*]
[*][b]Sleepy Totem[/b]: warps you beside the bed you last slept in, whether that's your farmhouse, your cabin, or Ginger Island. Recipe: 1 Void Essence, 1 Diamond, 1 Hardwood. Recipe sold by Krobus for 10,000g.[/*]
[*][b]Starward Totem[/b]: warps you to your own Starpoint. Recipe: 1 Solar Essence, 1 Diamond, 1 Hardwood. Recipe sold by Krobus for 10,000g, and buying it also gives the Starpoint recipe.[/*]
[*][b]Friendship Totem[/b]: choose any online farmer from a menu and warp right to them, even into their cabin or the mines. Recipe: 1 Iridium Bar, 1 Diamond, 1 Hardwood. Recipe sold by Krobus for 10,000g (multiplayer only).[/*]
[*][b]Hungry Totem[/b]: warps to the Saloon. Recipe: 1 Hardwood, 1 egg (any), 1 coffee. Unlocked by mail from Gus at 2 hearts[/*]
[/list]
[b]The Starpoint[/b]
[list]
[*]A placeable beacon that marks your personal warp spot. Recipe: 1 Starfruit, 30 Hardwood, 20 Solar Essence, 5 Iridium Bar.[/*]
[*]One per farmer, outdoors only, and it needs the 8 tiles around it to be empty, just like a fruit tree.[/*]
[*]Only its owner can pick it up with a pickaxe or axe, and bombs can't destroy it.[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Disclaimer [/size][/b]
[size=2]This is my first mod. I love coding, so I try to create a mod for one of my favorite games. Most of the sprites in this mod are reused from the game since I'm bad at designing new ones[/size]

[b]Fair by design[/b]
[list]
[*]Totems can't be used during events, festivals, or while swimming, just like vanilla totems.[/*]
[*]If a totem has nowhere to go (no Starpoint placed, no other players online), it isn't used up.[/*]
[*]Fully multiplayer compatible: each farmer has their own unlocks, bed, and Starpoint[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley 1.6 (latest version)[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI 4.5.2 or newer[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]No other mods are required. In multiplayer, all players must have Starwarp installed.[/color]
